name: Scicom (MSC) Berhad
overview: 2026 年，Scicom 的公告主要涉及股息派发、董事会委员会人事变动、地址变更及一项重大诉讼，未披露任何业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减、出售或合约签订事项。最新季度营收同比增长 70.0%，净利润同比增长 201.6%。
overview_en: In 2026, Scicom's announcements mainly covered dividend payments, changes in board committee memberships, change of address, and a material litigation; no expansion, new business, reduction, disposal, or contract wins were disclosed for any business segment. Latest quarterly revenue grew 70.0% year-on-year and net profit grew 201.6% year-on-year.
